$comment: Curated plugin catalog. LOCAL FILE ONLY: GET /api/plugin-runtime/registry merges it with live install state and never makes a network call. Listing something here installs nothing: a git/npm entry only PREFILLS the existing install form, which still requires the per-install trust acknowledgement. Users can add their own entries in ~/.open-walnut/plugin-registry.json (same shape, matched by id, theirs wins). Copied to dist/ by the `cp -r src/data dist/` build step.
